mainText: <speak><voice name="Joey">Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are enjoying a comfortable 72 degrees with mainly clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail under a bright full moon. There are no visible ISS passes expected tonight.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Joanna">In city news, the Senior Center is inviting residents to enjoy the outdoors with free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail, which requires a waiver. Also, the City Clerk is holding an I Voted sticker design contest for local students, with voting for the best designs open until August 7.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Kendra">We have plenty of fun ahead, including trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Tomorrow, you can head to Hometown Junction Park for the downtown Farmer's Market, enjoy pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or try your luck at trivia night at The Bogey Factory.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Justin">Looking back at the weekly police report, officers responded to a hit and run crash on Saturday near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane, which resulted in a citation for an 83 year old driver.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Salli">If you are craving a sweet treat, today's featured flavor is Georgia Peach. The restaurant is currently closed but will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.</voice></speak>
